text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho put on a magnificent run. No 
one could doubt any longer that she was a 
true representative of those who wear the 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer suggested making the 
Takarazuka Kinen their next goal to cast a 
spell over the whole world on the greatest 
stage, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She decided to enter the Yasuda Kinen just 
before it. The short turnaround was 
unheard of under normal circumstances, but 
pulling off super-sized magic meant 
breaking the mold.
